items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: If a guy wants to know about him and Russ Black, he says, well, I'm not.

ctx.x: It don't sound right. If a guy wants to know about him and Russ Black, he says, well, I'm not. If I pass away, he'd be something else, you know. He's a younger fella than me, twenty-five years younger than me. And he'd tell them, say, well, how about Henry Russ? Well, Henry Russ used to do so and so and so and so. See? But he'd say, well, I don't know all his life, but you can find him at such a place.
You get my point? Oh, absolutely. You're the one who knows the most about it.
